name: Orthofluorofentanyl
summary: Orthofluorofentanyl (o-fluorofentanyl, 2-fluorofentanyl) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug. While the structural isomer p-fluorofentanyl was one of the first illicit fentanyl analogues identified in 1981, Orthofluorofentanyl did not appear on the illicit market until August 2016.

uses.text: Orthofluorofentanyl (o-fluorofentanyl, 2-fluorofentanyl) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug. While the structural isomer p-fluorofentanyl was one of the first illicit fentanyl analogues identified in 1981, Orthofluorofentanyl did not appear on the illicit market until August 2016.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea, and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl it is an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor. Its effects can be reversed by naloxone.
pharmacology.zh: 與吩坦尼一樣，它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑，其作用可被納洛酮逆轉。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与吩坦尼一样，它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂，其作用可被纳洛酮逆转。

fact.en: Fluorine can be put at three places on fentanyl's phenyl ring, giving ortho, meta and para versions. Chemists have made all three, and they differ in strength.
fact.zh: 氟可以接在吩坦尼苯環上的三個位置，形成鄰位、間位與對位三種版本。化學家都合成過這三種，而它們的強度各不相同。
fact.zhHans: 氟可以接在吩坦尼苯环上的三个位置，形成邻位、间位与对位三种版本。化学家都合成过这三种，而它们的强度各不相同。
